journey.title: Refine the search and choose the highlighted fruit with Enter
journey.goal: After the suggestions are refined, Enter selects the suggestion that is highlighted

functionalJourney.title: Choose a fruit with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: Clicking a suggestion fills the fruit field

guards.title: Choose the second suggestion with arrow keys
guards.goal: ArrowDown twice and Enter selects the second suggestion

plan.root_cause: The navigation controller adds a keydown listener each time a new list is rendered, causing multiple listeners and stale focus state. When Enter is pressed, the outdated listener uses an incorrect currentFocus index, resulting in the wrong suggestion being selected.
plan.repair_strategy: Ensure the keydown listener is attached only once by adding a guard flag (_navigationListenerAttached) on the config object. The listener is attached only when no custom navigation function is provided and the flag is not set.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard navigation will correctly track focus and active descendant, ensuring that pressing Enter selects the currently highlighted suggestion.
functional_risks: If a custom navigation function is provided, we skip attaching our listener; the custom function must manage its own listeners.
The flag _navigationListenerAttached could theoretically clash with other code using the same property name, but this is unlikely given the limited scope.
verification_requirements: After typing 'b', pressing ArrowDown twice, typing 'l', pressing ArrowDown once, and pressing Enter, the input value must be 'Blackberry'.
Repeatedly opening and closing the suggestion list must not accumulate multiple keydown listeners.
If a custom navigation function is supplied via config.resultsList.navigation, it should continue to work as expected.

plan.root_cause: The navigation controller uses closure variables (currentFocus, dataFeedback) that become stale when the suggestion list is re-rendered. The keydown listener is attached only once (via a guard flag) but retains references to the initial render's state. When the user types additional characters, the list updates but the listener's closure still holds the old focus index and results, causing incorrect aria-selected assignment and Enter selection.
plan.repair_strategy: Store navigation state (currentFocus, dataFeedback) on the config object (the autoComplete instance) so they persist across renders and are always current. Reset config.currentFocus to -1 and update config.dataFeedback each time navigate is called. Modify the inner functions to read/write these config properties. Keep the guard flag to attach the keydown listener only once.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard navigation will correctly track focus and active descendant across list re-renders, ensuring that pressing Enter selects the currently highlighted suggestion.
functional_risks: If a custom navigation function is provided, it will not benefit from the shared state on config; it must manage its own focus tracking.

The config object now has additional properties (currentFocus, dataFeedback, _navigationListenerAttached) which could theoretically clash with other code, but this is unlikely given the limited scope.
verification_requirements: After typing 'b', pressing ArrowDown twice, typing 'l', pressing ArrowDown once, and pressing Enter, the input value must be 'Blackberry'.
Repeatedly opening and closing the suggestion list must not accumulate multiple keydown listeners.
If a custom navigation function is supplied via config.resultsList.navigation, it should continue to work as expected.
